say:1:1130405001:1.text: It's no sweat. The privilege of standing guard for these fierce bouts is well worth it.
say:1:1130405001:1.source_cn: 嗨，不辛苦，能保护这样精彩的比赛，我们也觉得值得了。
say:1:1130405001:1.male: It's no sweat. The privilege of standing guard for these fierce bouts is well worth it.
say:1:1130405001:1.female: It's no sweat. The privilege of standing guard for these fierce bouts is well worth it.

say:2:1130405002:1.text: After all, this honor isn't afforded to just anyone.
say:2:1130405002:1.source_cn: 毕竟，这样的荣耀，也不是所有人都能获取的。
say:2:1130405002:1.male: After all, this honor isn't afforded to just anyone.
say:2:1130405002:1.female: After all, this honor isn't afforded to just anyone.
